title: Morning outdoor light — 10 minutes
hypothesis: Getting brief outdoor light within ~60 minutes of waking will subjectively improve morning alertness and make bedtime feel more natural over 14 days.

intervention.summary: Spend about 10 minutes outdoors after waking without sunglasses if safe for your eyes and environment.
steps: Within about an hour of waking, go outdoors (balcony, street, garden).
Do not stare at the sun.
Log wake time, light session, and evening sleepiness (1-10).

timing.phase_note: Prefer natural daylight; if outdoor access is impossible, note barrier rather than forcing unsafe conditions.

expected_effect.note: Effects are individual; stop if headache, eye pain, or mood worsens.

stop_conditions: Eye pain, severe headache, or dizziness associated with the practice
contraindications: Photosensitizing medication or clinician-advised light restriction
Active eye injury or post-eye-surgery restrictions
Bipolar spectrum or light-sensitive conditions without clinician guidance

safety.emergency_route: For emergency symptoms call local emergency services.
